title: P1 Frontend API bridge + store 补全测试 (writing callApi bridge + backendSlice + workspaceSlice + loadingSlice)
description: 为 P1 frontend 层补全测试：(1) writing API bridge callApi 包装和类型映射需回归测试（现有 writing.test.ts 和 writing.additional.test.ts 主要覆盖 stream 和 polishContentCompat，基础 callApi 路径覆盖不足）；(2) backendSlice/workspaceSlice/loadingSlice 三个 Zustand slice 零测试覆盖。
action: Create backendSlice.test.ts, workspaceSlice.test.ts, loadingSlice.test.ts under desktop/src/stores/app/ using createHarness pattern; create writing.branches.additional.test.ts under desktop/src/api/ using vi.hoisted + vi.mock('./core') pattern

criteria: cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/backendSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/workspaceSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/loadingSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/api/writing.branches.additional.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
convergence.verification: Run vitest for each new test file in desktop/ and confirm all pass with 0 failures
convergence.definition_of_done: backendSlice、workspaceSlice、loadingSlice 均有基础测试覆盖状态转换和错误路径，writing API bridge 有 branch coverage 补充测试，所有测试通过

files.change: Create test: backendStatus defaults false, checkBackend with mocked checkBackendHealth healthy=true sets true, healthy=false sets false, checkBackendHealth throws sets false

Create test: currentWorkspace defaults from createDefaultProjectWorkspaceContext, setCurrentWorkspace merges partial workspace, syncConversationWorkspace with active conversation merges both current and conversation workspace, syncConversationWorkspace with missing conversation returns state unchanged
Create test: loadingMap defaults {}, startLoading sets id=true, finishLoading sets id=false, isLoading returns true for active, false for missing, multiple concurrent loading states

Create companion test covering: processWritingHelper error response propagation (success:false with error message), callApi payload shape verification for all writing helper modes, edge cases in polishContentCompat (mode mapping: business/creative/academic/standard → instruction strings), error envelope unwrapping

implementation: Read backendSlice.ts: simple async slice with checkBackend() that calls checkBackendHealth() and sets backendStatus, catch → sets false

Create backendSlice.test.ts: import createBackendSlice + type BackendSlice, createHarness with stub defaults, vi.mock('@/api/client') for checkBackendHealth, test: backendStatus initial false, checkBackend with mock resolving true → backendStatus true, resolving false → false, throwing → false
Read workspaceSlice.ts: setCurrentWorkspace uses mergeProjectWorkspaceContext, syncConversationWorkspace uses resolveConversationWorkspaceForSync from shared.ts

Create workspaceSlice.test.ts: createHarness with currentWorkspace + conversationsById, test: currentWorkspace starts as createDefaultProjectWorkspaceContext(), setCurrentWorkspace merges partial, syncConversationWorkspace for active conversation updates both workspaces, syncConversationWorkspace for missing conversation returns state unchanged
Read loadingSlice.ts: startLoading/finishLoading set loadingMap[id], isLoading reads with ?? false fallback

Create loadingSlice.test.ts: createHarness, test: loadingMap starts {}, startLoading('x') → {x: true}, finishLoading('x') → {x: false}, isLoading('x') returns true/false correctly, isLoading('missing') returns false (?? fallback), multiple concurrent loading states coexist

Read writing.ts to identify uncovered callApi paths: processWritingHelper, streamWritingHelper, polishContentCompat — check which branches existing tests miss (writing.additional.test.ts covers streaming extensively but may miss basic processWritingHelper error branches and polishContentCompat mode→instruction mapping edge cases)

Create writing.branches.additional.test.ts: vi.hoisted + vi.mock('./core'), test processWritingHelper with callApi returning {success: false, error: 'msg'} → propagates error, test polishContentCompat with all polishType values (business, creative, academic, standard) verifying instruction mapping, test polishContentCompat with callApi error envelope

commands: cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/backendSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/workspaceSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/loadingSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose
success_metrics: all writing branch coverage tests pass

reference.pattern: Zustand slice companion test pattern (createHarness) + API bridge test pattern (vi.hoisted + vi.mock('./core'))

rationale.chosen_approach: Group frontend layer additions into one task — all 4 files are small, independent, and follow established patterns. backendSlice/workspaceSlice/loadingSlice are very small slices (10-40 lines each) that need simple harness tests. writing.branches.additional.test.ts adds targeted branch coverage.
decision_factors: backendSlice is 20 lines (very simple, but zero tests — P1 risk)
workspaceSlice is 43 lines (depends on shared.ts helpers — P1 risk)
loadingSlice is 20 lines (trivial but zero tests)
writing.ts already has 2 test files but branch coverage gaps remain
rationale.tradeoffs: Combining 4 small files into one task reduces agent spawn overhead. Each file is <60 lines of test code, so total implementation time stays reasonable

risks: workspaceSlice.syncConversationWorkspace depends on conversationsById state (cross-slice) — harness needs to include conversation state
workspaceSlice uses resolveConversationWorkspaceForSync from shared.ts which is already tested in shared.test.ts — may have subtle interaction differences
writing.ts mode→instruction mapping may have changed since existing tests were written — read writing.ts first
